name: @djgrant/freeagent/delete-invoice
description: Marks an unpaid FreeAgent invoice as Draft and permanently deletes it, reversing its sales and receivables rather than writing it off as bad debt. A written-off invoice must be reopened first.

reads: FreeAgent invoice page and draft transition result
writes: FreeAgent account (marks the selected unpaid invoice as Draft and permanently deletes it, reversing its accounting entries)

rejected.matches: ($draft_invoice.status >= 400 or ($exists($draft_invoice) and $draft_invoice.status >= 200 and $draft_invoice.status < 300 and $draft_invoice.body.invoice.status != 'Draft') or $deleted.status >= 400) and $not($exists($draft_invoice.status) and $draft_invoice.status = 401) and $not($exists($deleted.status) and $deleted.status = 401)

rejected.hint: FreeAgent rejected the deletion. Remove any payment first; if the invoice is written off, reopen it before retrying.
